scenario.description: A pathology operations manager must assign the hospital's one overnight molecular-testing slot between two patient specimens and finalize the assay, specimen handoff, and alternative testing plan for the specimen that does not receive the slot.

shared_context.S1: The pathology department has one overnight molecular-testing slot available for specimens from Patient Alder and Patient Brook.
shared_context.S2: The other specimen can be sent to an outside laboratory through the usual referral process.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the final testing-slot assignment and records the operational plan.
shared_context.S4: The specimens are currently in the pathology receiving area and have not yet been assigned to the overnight run.
shared_context.S5: As part of the department's routine end-of-day handoff, Marisol checks with the ordering clinician, the molecular laboratory, and research coordination before closing the run list.

PF1.text: Patient Alder's treatment conference is scheduled for Monday at 12:00, and the conference requires an RNA fusion panel result before it begins; Dr. Chen confirmed this with the oncology team, but the conference requirement is not yet on the pathology requisition.

PF2.text: Patient Alder's specimen must be transferred to molecular laboratory staff by 18:00 today and kept frozen for the RNA extraction workflow; Ibrahim verified the handling requirement in the bench protocol, which has not been attached to the case record.

PF3.text: Patient Brook is enrolled in a study that permits the required molecular test to be performed by the contracted outside laboratory, with a confirmed Monday 09:00 send-out appointment; Leah obtained the appointment confirmation from the study vendor.

acceptance_conditions: Patient Alder must receive the overnight molecular-testing slot because the RNA fusion panel is needed for the Monday treatment conference.
The assay for Patient Alder must be recorded as an RNA fusion panel.
Patient Alder's specimen must be handed to the molecular laboratory by 18:00 today.
Patient Brook's outside-laboratory alternative must be documented for the confirmed Monday 09:00 appointment.
The clinical urgency for Patient Alder must be explicitly cited in the justification.

content_checks.C4: any('Brook' in c['detail'] and ('outside laboratory' in c['detail'] or 'outside lab' in c['detail']) and 'Monday 09:00' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The Monday 12:00 treatment conference changes the overnight recipient to Patient Alder and specifies that the required assay is an RNA fusion panel.
The molecular bench protocol changes Alder's specimen handoff from an unspecified timing to the exact 18:00-today deadline.
The contracted laboratory confirmation changes Brook's alternative from a generic referral to a documented outside molecular test at Monday 09:00.
